scripts.title: Infinite Money, Unlock All Skins Asec Hub
scripts.features:
[+] Combat

Silent Aim: Automatically redirects attacks to targets without locking your camera.

Auto Smack: Instantly smacks nearby opponents without manual input.

Auto Block: Automatically parries and blocks incoming incoming strikes.

Hitbox Expander: Enlarges opponent hitboxes for effortless hits.

[+] Player

Unlock Shiftlock: Enables shiftlock functionality regardless of game restrictions.

Anti-Fall Platform: Spawns a platform underneath you to prevent falling into lava or voids.

No Ragdoll: Bypasses ragdoll states so your character recovers immediately.

[+] ESP

Name: Displays player usernames through walls.

Distance: Shows exact player distance in studs.

Ability: Reveals active abilities and loadouts of opponents.

Health Bar: Displays visual health status for all players on screen.

[+] Automation

Cash Farm: Automatically runs and completes the obby to farm infinite cash.

Crate Opener: Automates crate opening for faster reward processing.

Free Premium Crates: Bypasses Robux costs on premium crates to grant unlimited cash and unlock all skins instantly.
